label: Round one's D2 (Codex-only changes passing unchecked) is closed in the current tree: the checker regex includes codex, its orphan list looks for .codex mirrors, both pre-commit hooks include codex paths, and the pre-commit mirror gate runs the dedicated Codex sync checks. VERIFIED CLOSURE; the parent should not reopen it as pending.

The Hermes agent-persona mirror check runs only in CI: sync-skills-hermes.cjs mirrors .skilled/agents personas into .hermes/skills/agent-* with a --check mode, CI runs both Hermes checks, but pre-commit has zero Hermes references and no .hermes entry in its mirror lists, the doctor runtime-mirror config has zero Hermes entries, and the doctor update route checks only Hermes prompts while the doctor doc claims agent mirrors too. NEW, same failure class as the closed D2.

The OpenCode-dialect agent body exists in three byte-identical copies (.skilled/agents, .opencode/agents, .hermes/agents) with no equality check between them: each checker compares a different pair, the doctor roster check treats .skilled as presence-only, and the Hermes and Pi syncs source from .skilled, so an edit that satisfies one pair checker can leave the other copies stale with every local gate green. NEW, latent.

Ponytail's adapter-thinness rule is substantively implemented: Cursor agents are symlinks resolving to the Claude canonical, Devin and Codex trees are generated, and the runtime-mirrors policy documents which dialect each host parses. ALREADY-ADOPTED, no action.
